evidence.name: DriverInputController

function_ir.summary: Per-frame driver input controller tick. Dispatches enable/disable to four audio sub-controllers from global byte_7C56AC, derives wheel-speed magnitudes from the player vehicle (dword_7C54E0), folds wheel-contact types into per-frame gains and flags, then runs a ten-channel dispatch (steering, brake, throttle, rotation force-feedback, rumble) that computes effort/headroom/raw outputs and pushes them through each channel object's vtable. Zeroes the six rotation doubles at this+0x560..0x574 and returns 0.

local_names.v20: wheel-type dependent gain, raised for front wheels on contact types 6/7
local_names.v79: differential/force-simulation active flag from dword_7C54E8 vs dword_7C54E0
local_names.v83: active-axle wheel speed magnitude from the player vehicle
local_names.v84: lateral command offset built from wheel contact type 11 per wheel index
local_names.v85: max of the two wheel speed magnitudes
local_names.v81: raw channel output, clamped to [-10000,10000] or [-5000,5000]

operations.description: Audio sub-controller enable/disable dispatch: when global byte_7C56AC is nonzero and the latched init byte at this+0x418 is clear, walk each of the four sub-controller pointers this+0x4E8/0x4EC/0x4F0/0x4F4, follow the inner object at +0x80 and its vtable at +0, and when present call vtable slot +0x58 with argument 32 (enable); when byte_7C56AC is zero and this+0x418 is set, call the same slots with argument 16 (disable). Latch this+0x418 to 1 or 0 afterwards

Wheel-speed magnitudes from the player vehicle: select the front-axle magnitude at offset 14004 of dword_7C54E0 when offsets 2396 and 2460 are active, else the rear-axle magnitude at offset 13756 when offsets 2100 and 2164 are active, else 0.0, into v83; then set v85 to the larger of the absolute values at offsets 14252 and 14500

Reset per-frame accumulators: zero this+0x4D0, this+0x4D8 and this+0x4E0, zero v84, and compute v79 = (dword_7C54E8 != dword_7C54E0) OR (dword_7C54E8 + 13000) OR ((dword_7C54E8 + 13388) && dword_7CE7A8)

Four-iteration scan over wheel entries at dword_7C54E0+13940 (stride 248). For each entry holding an object at +84, accumulate the wheel-type value at +48 into this+0x4E0 and switch on it: type 6 or 7 adds 0.4 to the gain v20 for the front two wheels; type 9 or 10 sets this+0x4D8; type 11 sets this+0x4D0 and adjusts v84 per wheel index (+1.0, -1.0, +0.25, -0.25)
Cache global byte_7D1358 as v24; when v79 is active force v84 to 0 and, if byte_7D1358 is clear, also clear this+0x4D0 and this+0x4D8
Scale the wheel-type gain v20 by flt_7D21AC into v87

Ten-iteration dispatch over channel records laid out stride 104 from 'this'. A channel is live when the byte at +4 is nonzero and its object pointer at +100 is present; the record index (0..9) selects the handling block below

Channel 0 (steering) feedback curve: derive a normalized factor from the front/axle state of dword_7C54E0 with gain terms dbl_7C77F8 and dbl_7C7C5C, blend it through dbl_7C8A80 / flt_7D2164, apply the shape flt_7D2140 (0.5 -> sqrt, 2.0 -> square, otherwise the sub_5881F0 helper), weight by flt_7D2188 and flt_7D211C and persist the filtered result into flt_7CD1F8 clamped to [-1,1] with the sign kept; combine the clamp shape flt_7CC130 / flt_7CC15C with the front velocity at dword_7C54E0+13696 into the raw output v81 (clamped to [-5000,5000]), then compare the stored position this+0x420 against a CRTFtol-scaled tolerance of flt_7D21D0 times 10000 using wheel speed this+0x4C0

Channel 0 (steering) effort selection and dispatch: gate on v83, flt_7D208C, dword_7D1FFC and the v79/byte_7D1358 state; compute effort from flt_7D20D4*v83 + flt_7D20B0*10000 clamped to [0,10000] and a CRTFtol tolerance flt_7D21D0 around this+0x428, gated by this+0x41C and the latched init byte this+0x418; on update store effort into this+0x41C, headroom into this+0x428, raw CRTFtol(v81) into this+0x420 and push the channel message via vtable +24, or clear the outputs when the init byte is set

Channel 5 (brake) effort: when the pedal magnitude at dword_7C54E0+14752 is non-positive, the init byte this+0x418 is set, a specific mismatch condition (v85, this+0x2D4, this+0x510/0x514 equality and this+0x4F0/0x4F4 equality) holds, or the v79/byte_7D1358 combination is not 1, force effort 0 and headroom 1000000. Otherwise, for gear state dword_7D1FD8==3 scale the brake delta (14752 - 400) by 6.8965516 through flt_7D22A8, or for other gears read this+0x4C4 divided by 14752 with headroom 1000000 and gain flt_7D22CC*... + flt_7D22A8*10000 clamped to [0,10000]; both paths clamp v81 to [-10000,10000]. Compare the stored this+0x498 against tolerance flt_7D2314 (this+0x48C/0x490) and dispatch via vtable +24

Channel 6 (throttle) effort: when the throttle magnitude at dword_7C54E0+13700 is non-positive, v85 is zero, the init byte this+0x418 is set, or the v79/byte_7D1358 combination is not 1, force headroom 1000000 and effort 0. Otherwise effort from this+0x4C8 divided by v85 (headroom 1000000 when out of range), gain flt_7D2380*10000 + flt_7D235C*10000 clamped to [0,10000], tolerance flt_7D23C8 around this+0x4A8 and this+0x49C; store headroom to this+0x4A8 and effort to this+0x49C, then dispatch

Channel 7 (rotation force-feedback): when v79 is clear and the init byte this+0x418 is clear, track a change of this+0x4E0 against this+0x4E4 (accumulating v83 * 0.0033333334 * 40000 into the double at this+0x560 when it changes), then when any of the doubles this+0x560 / this+0x570 / this+0x568 are non-zero, build v92/v93 through the rotation matrix dword_7C8A18 (coefficients at offsets +28/+44/+52/+68/+76/+92), select single-wheel mode when dword_7D1FD8==3 and this+0x4E8 is set, or mirrored mode when this+0x4E8 and this+0x4F4 are equal and dword_7D2068 is clear, clamp CRTFtol(this+0x570) into this+0x4AC within [-10000,10000], then dispatch via vtable +24 and +28

Channel 8 (rumble/audio-motor): when v83 is zero, or in gear state dword_7D1FD8==3 with this+0x4D0 clear and this+0x4D8 set, compute effort from this+0x4CC divided by v83 (headroom 1000000 out of range), gain flt_7D23EC (times 10000, or times 8000 when this+0x4D8 set) and raw v81 from this+0x4B0 times flt_7D2458 times v84 (clamped to [-10000,10000]); store into this+0x4B0, this+0x4B4 and this+0x4BC (or force 0/0/1000000 when the init byte this+0x418 is set) subject to the tolerance flt_7D247C, mirror this+0x4D0/0x4D8 into this+0x4D4/0x4DC, dispatch via vtable +24, and on shutdown clear this+0x4D0/0x4D4/0x4D8/0x4DC and call vtable +32
Per-frame cleanup: zero the six rotation/double slots this+0x560, this+0x564, this+0x568, this+0x56C, this+0x570 and this+0x574 and return 0
Invoked per frame by MainGameTickUpdate (0042c690) as the driver input controller update tick

clean_pseudocode: // enable/disable the four audio sub-controllers by byte_7C56AC and latch this+0x418;
v83 = axle-speed abs from dword_7C54E0 wheel masks; v85 = max axle abs;
clear this+0x4D0/0x4D8/0x4E0; v84 = 0.0; v79 = differential-state test;
scan 4 wheel entries at dword_7C54E0+13940 and fold types into v20, this+0x4D0, this+0x4D8, v84;
if (live byte at this+104*channel+4 and object at +100)
switch (channel) { 0: steering; 5: brake; 6: throttle; 7: rotation feedback; 8: rumble; }
